purpose: pilot quarter-level Sumatera Barat investment-realization materialization on three locked periods after source, schema, public transport, period identity, and Sumbar search qualification

target_metrics.source_semantics: nilai tambahan realisasi dari laporan LKPM
nilai tambahan realisasi dari laporan LKPM

within_quarter_addition_basis: the official dataset describes rows as an aggregation grouped by sector, project location, and investor country and defines both investment fields as additional realization reported through LKPM; aggregation is allowed only after exact source-dimension duplicate checks and row-level period/geography validation
row_period_validation_rule: every accepted Sumatera Barat row must parse to the preregistered year-quarter; any mismatch holds the entire pilot period
province_validation_rule: every returned row must normalize exactly to Sumatera Barat; any false-positive global-search row holds the pilot rather than being silently dropped
geography_mapping_rule: kabupaten_kota must expose an explicit kabupaten/regency or kota/city type and a normalized name that maps uniquely to the preregistered 19-geography contract; ambiguous or unknown labels hold the entire pilot period
duplicate_dimension_rule: within each pilot response the complete 11-field source dimension tuple must be unique; any duplicate holds the pilot period from aggregation
missing_metric_rule: null or blank target values remain missing; a geography-quarter-status metric sum is emitted only when every contributing row for that metric is non-missing; missing values are never coerced to zero
numeric_parse_rule: preserve source numeric text via Decimal-compatible parsing; finite signed source values are retained as reported and negative values, if any, are counted explicitly rather than silently rejected or clipped
no_observed_rows_rule: absence of a geography/status group produces no numeric observation and must not be materialized as zero
pilot_success_rule: all three locked responses must be complete relative to the already-qualified Sumbar search counts, all rows must pass schema/period/province/geography/status validation, complete dimension tuples must be unique, and at least one quarter-level geography-status metric observation must materialize without missing-as-zero
